description: London, the night clocks go forward: pre-sunrise birth across the change

place.name: London
place.note: Non-India test coverage: daylight-saving gap and repeated-hour handling.

ayanamsa.name: Lahiri
ayanamsa.definition: Lahiri (Chitrapaksha), Swiss Ephemeris SE_SIDM_LAHIRI (mode 1), IAE 1985 definition, true ayanamsha, Swiss default precession; no SIDBIT options

planetary_positions.frame: true ecliptic and equinox of date, minus the true ayanamsha

nodes.ketu: exactly opposite the unrounded mean Rahu; categories from the exact sum Rahu + 180

ascendant.definition: eastern rising point of the ecliptic, minus the true Lahiri ayanamsha
ascendant.note: The house-system argument selects the Swiss call only; the D1 house model is whole_sign. Cusps are not used.

conventions.classification: Rashi, Navamsa, Nakshatra, Pada and houses use unrounded longitudes on half-open segments, never the 8-decimal display

ephemeris_data.manifest_sha256_method: SHA-256 of the packaged ephemeris-manifest.json as canonical JSON (sorted keys, separators ',' and ':')
ephemeris_data.verification: every required file matched its size and SHA-256 before any Swiss call

timezone_data.verification: the zone file matched the pinned manifest SHA-256 before use

time_scale.pipeline: local civil time + explicit offset -> validated against the pinned IANA zone -> civil UTC -> swe.julday (Gregorian) -> Swiss UT-based calculation; TT from the Swiss automatic Delta T
time_scale.ut1_assumption: civil UTC is treated as UT1 (an assumption, not a measured UT1 correction)

delta_t.source: Swiss Ephemeris automatic Delta T (DELTAT_AUTOMATIC, reset per request)
delta_t.note: Swiss 2.10.03 tabulates Delta T to 2028 and extrapolates afterwards; future Delta T is a model projection

time_scale.era_description: After the pinned IERS leap-second list expiry (2027-06-28): continuous UTC under BIPM CGPM 2026 Resolution 5, whose 3 600 s maximum for |UT1-UTC| is a policy ceiling, not a measured value. Civil-time rules and UT1-UTC are not known; the converted UTC is treated as UT1 by projection, and Swiss Delta T is extrapolated.
time_scale.leap_second_list_source: IERS leap-seconds.list as shipped in tz 2026e (pinned research value; later IERS publications are not reflected)

sidereal_time_model.note: Swiss 2.10.03 switches its default sidereal-time model at 2050-01-01 0h UT (recorded step about -1.908 arcsec, Lagna about -1.7 arcsec at New Delhi). Version-specific model behaviour, not a precision guarantee.

local_date_window.basis: local civil date as written, before conversion

timezone_identifier.policy: KUN-03 D3 location-based birthplace timezone, version 2
timezone_identifier.rule: geographic IANA timezone identifier required (exact match)

input_policy.time_offset: explicit UTC offset required and must be an offset the pinned IANA zone gives for that wall time; nonexistent local times are refused; a repeated hour is resolved by the offset

disclosures.description: The birth instant is after the pinned IERS leap-second list expiry (2027-06-28): civil-time rules, leap seconds, UT1-UTC and Delta T are projections, not records.

validation.claim_boundary: Swiss-on-Swiss integration conformance only; not independent astronomical validation, mathematical verification or historical clock verification

panchanga.claim_boundary: Engineering output for independent QA only. Not customer-facing. Tithi and Karana transitions at E = 0, 90, 180, 270 deg are compared with USNO/NASA published minutes; everything else is rule-oracle and Swiss-on-Swiss conformance, not independent astronomical accuracy.

method.method_revision: SCI-PAN-01 rev 0.5 with KUN-PAN-M1-DEC-001 owner selections (adopted at main 25cfde4)
method.longitude_frame: SCI-01d geocentric apparent sidereal, Lahiri (SIDM_LAHIRI), calc_ut with FLG_SWIEPH | FLG_SIDEREAL; the chart's call path
method.elongation: E = (Moon - Sun) mod 360 on exact unrounded values
method.yoga_sum: S = (Sun + Moon) mod 360 on exact unrounded values
method.boundary_rule: half-open [start, end) on exact unrounded values; an edge value belongs to the higher sector
method.tithi_rule: number = sector(E, 30) + 1; paksha shukla for 1-15, krishna for 16-30; paksha_day = ((number - 1) mod 15) + 1
method.nakshatra_rule: the chart moon_nakshatra rule: pada sector(Moon, 108), nakshatra = pada div 4

transition_search.output: first whole UTC second in the new half-open sector, verified at that second and the second before

method.time_scale: civil UTC treated as UT1 (SCI-01h), as for the chart; Swiss automatic Delta T
method.precision_note: whole-second output is a resolution, not an accuracy claim

angles.note: 8-decimal display only; classification uses the unrounded values

local_rendering.offset_rule: pinned IANA tzdata (SCI-03), converted from the UTC instant; no rounding
local_rendering.outside_envelope: withheld_outside_envelope (D13-A); the UTC instant is still reported

vara.claim_boundary: Development output for independent QA only. Not customer-facing. Sunrise and sunset are calculated for the birthplace with a sea-level, level-horizon, geocentric model under the IMD 47' definition; they do not establish when the Sun was actually visible. Times are approximate to the minute. Published USNO and IMD times agree within a coarse 120 s screen, which is not an accuracy claim, and IMD's four-city tables are not reproduced by one depression angle.

method.convention_decision: PAN-D03 SUN-D-IMD-47 at the birthplace, adopted for the development stage only (PR #82 comment 6681108990); not released to customers
method.place: birthplace latitude and longitude of the chart request
method.observer: sea level, level horizon, geocentric; no weather, elevation, terrain or dip model
method.vara_rule: PAN-D05: weekday of the local civil date of the latest sunrise at or before the birth instant, [sunrise_D, sunrise_D+1); the civil weekday is shown separately, never substituted
method.day_end: the Vara is withheld when the next sunrise is physically undefined; a next sunrise after the supported local dates is not computed
method.sunset: PAN-D17: first setting after the governing sunrise, same 47' rule
method.near_sunrise: birth within 300 s (inclusive) of the governing or next sunrise, on unrounded instants; a presentation heuristic, not an accuracy bound
method.display: instants are whole UTC seconds here; reports round to the minute and mark them approximate
